items.body_excerpt:
October 21, 1995: Houston's Clyde Drexler drives for the lefty dunk over Orlando Woolridge during the Rockets' 126-112 win over Buckler Bologna at the McDonald's Championship in London.

Drexler finished with 25 PTS/10 AST/7 REB. Woolridge had 34 PTS/9 REB for Bologna.

items.title: Bonus Hollander COTD Doug Moe. Brooklyn hooper went to UNC & was good scorer in early ABA. Retired in 72 & went into coaching. First head gig was w/SA from 76-80 where he was good. Then coached DEN for the entire 80s, in playoffs 9x in 10 yrs & 85 WCF. Teams were high scoring.
